# research-lab

> A research lab for Claude Code. Two modes over one local knowledge base: the background mode (knowledge-search, knowledge-ingest and three hooks) answers from what is known; the direct mode (/research with two subagents) runs hypotheses in a simulation environment with written requirements, pre-registers the expected behaviour of every stage, has an independent reviewer compare expected with actual and turn discrepancies into the next hypotheses, judges a frozen candidate once on a holdout, and promotes durable results to the knowledge base. Retrieval is self-routing RAG (hybrid search, GraphRAG, corrective RAG, contextual retrieval, reranking, incremental updates). Python standard library only; installs as a Claude Code plugin or via install.sh.

## Start here
- [README](README.md): the two modes, a research round, environments, expected against actual, retrieval, install
- [Research skill](skills/research/SKILL.md): the loop step by step, the model-training protocol
- [Source rules](skills/knowledge-ingest/SOURCES.md): collecting knowledge and using the web
- [Knowledge router](docs/knowledge-router.md): building the knowledge base, retrieval, measurements
- [Hooks](docs/hooks.md): every hook, its event and environment variables
- [Components](docs/components.md): every skill, agent, hook and script
